items.text: Brewers trade Trent Grisham and Zach Davies to the Padres for Eric Lauer, Luis Urias and cash
Mike Mussina signs with the Yankees
Pirates trade cash and Jason Kendall to the Athletics for cash, Mark Redman and Arthur Rhodes
Ryne Sandberg signs with the Cubs
Eddie Murray signs with the Mets
Mets trade cash and Bill Denehy to the Senators for Gil Hodges
White Sox trade Minnie Minoso to the Cardinals for Joe Cunningham
Lou Boudreau signs with the Red Sox

note: 2026 regular-season games are not in Retrosheet yet, so 2026 here is postseason only, taken from Wikipedia's box scores. Retrosheet adds the full season after it ends.
